name: LegoZendo
author: chris (spec) / orchestrator (implementation)
description: Lego Zendo v2. Clue: capital letter x + number y in 0..12. Solution: an ASCII layout of 2-row x 3-column lego bricks (capital letters, any consistent non-letter filler). A CONNECTION is one brick stacked directly on another (adjacent 2-row bands) with a column overlap of 1, 2 or 3 studs (its pin width); side-by-side bricks do not connect. The whole layout must be connected through stacking connections, and EXACTLY y of the 1-pin connections must join two bricks of letter x. 2- and 3-pin x-x connections and 1-pin x-other connections are decoys. solve() rejection-samples random brick-wall layouts until the width histogram is near-uniform (each width 27-40%) and there are >= 5y connections (so contributing connections are <= 20%), then assigns letters (>= 5 distinct) to meet the count, adding decoy x bricks joined only by 2/3-pin edges. Human-designed rule; a test of invented rules vs model priors.
